items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: He used to talk to us a lot, and he loved to come down in the dressing room with his horn and play little things

ctx.x: So we boarded the train here one morning, headed for Kalamazoo, Michigan. We got there, and it was a nice place for us to break the band prior to going to Chicago, because a couple of weeks there, and the band got a chance to actually be exposed, and the audience was very... You know, everybody seemed to know Trummy Young at that particular time.

We left there and we went to Chicago to play a place called the Capital Lounge down on State Street. That was like just a paradise for a musician to be in, because at that particular time it seemed like everybody was in Chicago... There were names all over the place. We were at the Capital Lounge along with Muggsy Spanier's group, and the first time I'd ever... I'd heard about Muggsy Spanier, but I'd never met him. He was a very fine old man. He used to talk to us a lot, and he loved to come down in the dressing…
